headline: FastMCP: Build MCP Servers & Clients with Python
short_description: FastMCP is a powerful Python framework designed for building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients efficiently. With its user-friendly interface and strong features, developers can quickly create and manage MCP tools, enhancing their AI applications.
author: jlowin

sections.overview:
FastMCP is a Python framework designed for building Model Context Protocol servers and clients with a user-friendly interface. The framework provides strong features that allow developers to quickly create and manage MCP tools without complex setup. Built and maintained by PrefectHQ, FastMCP includes a CLI, examples, and documentation to help developers integrate MCP capabilities into their AI applications. The project supports both full and slim versions, with active development and security updates. Developers can use FastMCP to expose tools and resources to AI models like Claude through the standard MCP protocol.
Build and deploy AI model servers using the Model Context Protocol.
Create client applications that seamlessly interact with MCP servers.
Integrate MCP into existing AI workflows to enhance model context management.
Rapidly prototype AI solutions to test new ideas and features.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install jlowin/fastmcp`
`git clone https://github.com/jlowin/fastmcp`
